anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Quoted: Reuben, my firstborn and my strength and beginning of my children.

pass_a_gloss: This division of the first and the beginning Jacob too, having become Israel, blessing Reuben was saying thus: Reuben my firstborn and my strength and beginning of my children; for he knows him both being firstborn and being beginning of his children.
pass_b_english: This distinction of the first and the beginning Jacob too, when he had become Israel, used when blessing Reuben, speaking thus: "Reuben, my firstborn and my strength and beginning of my children." For he knows both that he is firstborn and that he is beginning of his children.
source_text: Ταύτην τὴν διαίρεσιν τοῦ πρώτου καὶ τῆς ἀρχῆς καὶ Ἰακὼβ ὁ Ἰ(σρα)ὴλ γενόμενος εὐλογῶν τὸν Ῥουβὴν ἔλεγεν οὕτως· "Ῥουβὴν πρωτότοκός μου καὶ ἰσχύς μου καὶ ἀρχὴ τέκνων μου"· οἶδεν γὰρ|| καὶ πρωτότοκον αὐτὸν ὄντα καὶ ἀρχὴν τέκνων αὐτοῦ ὑπάρχοντα.
